experiment_data.hypothesis: If targeted allocation is a robust Stage 1 mitigation, cate_error_product and capped/hybrid variants should show positive mean group5 coverage/bias gains over uniform across independent random seeds, with bounded overall CATE RMSE penalty; if gains change sign across seeds, the e005 claim must be weakened to seed-sensitive tradeoff.
